sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-FLAG immunofluorescence confirmed surface expression of the FLAG-tagged HTR1E construct; functional activity was assessed in the TANGO β-arrestin recruitment assay and the receptor was active.
sites.rationale: HTR1E has no native signal peptide; residues 1–22 form the sole extracellular N-terminal domain before TM1 (residue 23). The PRESTO-TANGO construct prepends an exogenous signal + FLAG to the native sequence, placing the FLAG at the mature extracellular N-terminus (insert_after_residue = 0, residue_after = M1). This is the only extracellular terminus available for an N-terminal tag, so the position is topology-derived. Surface expression was directly confirmed by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence, and the receptor was functional in the TANGO assay. PRESTO-TANGO platform (Kroeze et al. 2015, PMC4424118) engineered an exogenous cleavable signal sequence followed by a FLAG epitope tag at the N-terminus of each GPCR construct including HTR1E. HTR1E has no native signal peptide (topology: residues 1–22 extracellular), so the FLAG is placed immediately before native residue 1 (the mature extracellular N-terminus). Cell-surface display was confirmed by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence in transfected cells.

sources.claim: At the 5′-end, we included a cleavable signal sequence to promote membrane localization 23 and a FLAG epitope tag in order to be able to monitor cell surface expression by immunohistochemistry.

literature_notes: L3 (C-terminal Myc tag, Origene plasmid) was evaluated: the C-terminus of HTR1E (residues 348–365) is intracellular per the topology landmarks, so this tag is not on the extracellular face and cannot serve as a surface epitope tag site. It is recorded in other_positions. L1 and L2 both ground the same N-terminal FLAG site (L1 describes the construct design, L2 confirms surface expression); L1 is used as the primary supporting clip. No ledger evidence supports any internal extracellular loop (ECL1, ECL2, ECL3) insertion for HTR1E.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal Myc tag on full-length HTR1E (Origene plasmid); the C-terminus (residues 348–365) is intracellular per topology, so this is not a surface tag site.
